scope: Read-only deployed application, evaluator source and effective service configuration inventory; no hardware reconfiguration or inference run.
source_normalization: CRLF to LF only; use board_sha256 for exact deployed bytes and lf_sha256 for repository source equivalence.
omissions: Access tokens, SSH credentials, upload data, private histories, model tensors, bitstreams, native binaries and system dependencies are not included.
